title: Verify Service Advisor cannot see AP/AR tabs on customer and vendor pages
preconds:
Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Service Advisor role. (this role has Manage Accounts Payable and Receivable OFF).
Note: the role may display as 'Junior Service Advisor' in the build (the spec calls it 'Service Advisor').
At least one customer and one vendor exist.
steps:
1. Click Customers and open a customer.
2. Look for Unpaid Invoices, Payments, and Credits tabs on the customer page.
3. Click Vendors and open a vendor.
4. Look for the equivalent AP/AR tabs on the vendor page.
expected: The Unpaid Invoices, Payments, and Credits tabs are HIDDEN on both the customer page and the vendor page. (Known failure SV-8110 was raised when these were visible - retest.)
